outcome: Number of neuron cells in the cerebrum of newborn Rattus norvegicus
Number of neuron cells in the cerebellum of newborn Rattus norvegicus
cohort: The participants were 30 pregnant Rattus norvegicus and their newborn offspring.
finding: Murotal sound stimulation during pregnancy increased the number of neuron cells in the cerebrum and cerebellum of newborn rats, although statistical tests showed no significant differences between the groups.
